enableCard.title: Lead Management System
enableCard.description: Controls whether lead scoring, tier badges, and the lead sidebar tab are visible institute-wide. Disabling hides all lead UI without deleting data.

visibilityCard.title: Score Badge Visibility
visibilityCard.description: Choose where the lead score badge appears.

allLeadsCard.title: All Leads View
allLeadsCard.description: Choose whether converted leads appear in the unfiltered "All leads" view of Recent Leads and lead lists. You can still see them by picking "Enrolled / Converted" or your converted status in the Lead Status filter, or on the Lead Board.
allLeadsCard.hideConverted: Hide converted leads from All leads
allLeadsCard.showConvertedFilter: Offer "Enrolled / Converted" in the Lead Status filter
allLeadsCard.showConvertedFilterHint: This is the built-in option that finds leads enrolled into a course. Turn it off if your own converted status already covers it — most institutes have one, and the two sit next to each other looking almost identical.

followUpsCard.title: Follow-ups
followUpsCard.description: Choose which leads appear in the Follow-ups page.
followUpsCard.hideLostHint: Lost leads are left out of every Follow-ups tab: Today, Upcoming, Overdue, All and Completed. Turn this off to show them.

weightsCard.title: Scoring Weights
weightsCard.description: Each factor contributes its weight percentage to the final score (0–100). Weights must sum to exactly 100.

sourceQuality.label: Source Quality
sourceQuality.description: Score based on how the lead came in (e.g. Walk-in > Google Ads > Manual)

profileCompleteness.label: Profile Completeness
profileCompleteness.description: Percentage of key fields filled (name, email, phone, class, etc.)

recency.label: Recency
recency.description: Time decay — newer leads score higher, older ones decay

engagement.label: Engagement
engagement.description: Number of timeline notes and interactions recorded

recencyCard.title: Recency Decay
recencyCard.description: Number of days before a lead's recency score starts to decay toward 0. A lead submitted today scores 100 for recency; one submitted {{days}} days ago scores ~50.

terminologyCard.title: Terminology
terminologyCard.description: Call the built-in lead attributes what your team calls them. Leave blank to keep the defaults.
terminologyCard.hint: Used in the leads table headers, filters, lead side-view and these settings. Save with the button below.
